name: v0.3.50 — Cleaner dashboard header with a live snapshot
releaseNotes:
• Dashboard header now shows a live snapshot — your spend and receipt count for the selected window — right under a time-aware greeting (Good morning/afternoon/evening).
• One clean feature launcher: the horizontal pill scroll (the duplicate icon row and bottom strip are gone).
• Sign out moved into Menu → Profile, freeing up the top bar.
• Centre camera (Add Receipt) and the View-deal fix from earlier are included.
